note: Standard joins two senses (funny + absurd); reduce to funny/comical.

changes.def_ja_standard: おどけていて、見ている人が笑いたくなるようす。
changes.def_en_standard: comical; funny; humorous — amusing enough to make people laugh
changes.def_zh_standard: 滑稽；可笑 —— 言行诙谐、令人发笑

note: Standard joins the act of commenting and the words themselves; keep a single sense.

changes.def_ja_standard: ある物事について述べた意見や感想の言葉。
changes.def_zh_standard: 评论；意见 —— 对事物发表的意见或感想

note: 耐性 is not natural Chinese for 'patience'; use 耐心.

changes.def_zh_standard: 耐心；毅力 —— 不厌倦地坚持下去的精力

note: Standard lists two actions and two kinds of object; reduce to rebuilding a building, as the hint indicates.

changes.def_ja_standard: 壊れたり焼けたりした建物を、もう一度建てること。
changes.def_zh_standard: 重建 —— 把毁坏的建筑重新建造起来

note: zh gives two different senses (核算 and 收支平衡) and doesn't match the 'profit' hint.

changes.def_zh_standard: 盈利；效益 —— 比较收入与成本后能否获利

note: Standard joins 'the best' and 'one's utmost'; the hint is only 'the very best'. The example used the utmost sense.

changes.def_en_standard: the best; optimal — the most favorable option
changes.def_zh_standard: 最好；最佳 —— 最为理想
changes.example_ja: さいぜんのほうほうをえらびます。

note: Joins 'block a view' and 'interrupt speech'; reduce to the interrupt sense and drop the word itself from the example's reading context.

changes.def_ja_standard: 人の話や動きを途中で止めてじゃまをする。
changes.def_en_standard: to interrupt; to cut off — to stop someone partway through
changes.def_zh_standard: 打断；截断 —— 在中途阻止他人说话或行动

note: Draft defines 'first/before others' but the hint is 'before, earlier, previously'.

changes.def_ja_standard: ある時より前に。以前に。
changes.def_en_standard: previously; earlier — at a time before now
changes.def_zh_standard: 先前；此前 —— 在现在或某个时间之前
changes.example_ja: さきにのべたとおりです。

note: Standard joins the act and the voice, and uses the verb form of the word.

changes.def_ja_standard: 大声をあげて呼ぶこと。
changes.def_en_standard: shout; cry — a loud call let out
changes.def_zh_standard: 叫喊；呼声 —— 大声发出的喊叫

note: Joins 'hold out' and 'submit'; reduce to holding out/presenting. The standard also repeats the word itself.

changes.def_ja_standard: 手や物を相手の前に出す。
changes.def_en_standard: to hold out; to present — to put something forward to someone
changes.def_zh_standard: 递出；伸出 —— 把手或物品伸向对方

note: en/zh glosses don't match the hint (interfere, hinder); zh standard is a phrase rather than an equivalent set.

changes.def_en_standard: to interfere; to hinder — to cause inconvenience
changes.def_zh_standard: 妨碍；影响 —— 给事情带来不便
